methodology: Two independent random samples of 30 triplets each (seed=42 and seed=43, reproducible via scripts/audit_kg_sample.py) drawn from the final released 5,065-triplet AlzKG and pooled to n=60. We originally reported a single n=30 (seed=42) sample as the post-fix result, but iterating on the underlying corpus (see 'corpus_completeness_fix' below) surfaced enough run-to-run variance across successive n=30 draws during development (correct-triplet rates ranging roughly 17%-40% across draws on graphs that differed only slightly) that a single 30-item sample was judged too noisy to report as the final number. We therefore drew a second, independent sample (seed=43) from the actual released graph and pool both for the headline figure, while still reporting each seed's own tally so the run-to-run spread itself is visible rather than hidden. For each triplet, the first supporting paper's grounding sentence (the sentence whose recognized-entity list contains both the head and tail entity) was retrieved and manually judged by a Claude (Sonnet 5) instance for whether it actually supports the claimed relation, using three labels: 'correct' (sentence supports the specific relation and direction claimed), 'partial' (a real but looser/broader/reversed-direction/hedged association, a well-established general fact only indirectly evidenced by this specific sentence, or a scale mismatch such as cellular vs. patient-level outcomes), and 'incorrect' (the sentence does not support the claim at all -- most often a false entity match, a lost relation direction/valence, a list/glossary/methods-section co-occurrence rather than an asserted relation, or an off-topic sentence).
corpus_completeness_fix: After the lexicon-bug fix (see 'previous_audit' below) and before finalizing this release, we discovered that the original PMC fetch (data/corpus/fulltext_sentences.jsonl, ~2 months stale) had silently fallen back to abstract-only content for 943 of 7,150 papers (13.2%) -- almost certainly transient fetch failures during the original bulk run, not a stable 'no full text available' property of those articles, since a fresh re-fetch of the identical PMCIDs successfully retrieved full text for nearly all of them. We re-fetched the full corpus (7,150 papers, 337,047 raw candidate sentences before re-annotation) and re-ran entity detection with the fully-fixed lexicon (a background re-fetch process had started before three of the lexicon fixes were added, so its own baked-in entity annotations were stale in a different way; we discarded them and re-detected entities from its raw sentence text with the current code instead), yielding 320,299 final candidate sentences and the released 5,065-triplet graph (up from 5,026 on the incomplete corpus). This is a real, previously-undisclosed data-completeness issue, distinct from the entity-disambiguation bugs below, and is reported in the paper as such.

interim_audit_on_incomplete_corpus.note: An earlier post-fix audit (n=30, seed 42) was run on the fixed lexicon but the corpus-completeness bug above had not yet been found; reported here for the historical record, superseded by this file's pooled n=60 result.

new_failure_modes_confirmed_recurring: Lab-technique-as-biomarker / methods-artifact category errors recur heavily in this larger sample: 'Blotting, Western' (x2), 'Staining and Labeling', 'Excluded' (a QC/eligibility-criteria term, x2), 'Cell Culture Techniques' -- an overly generic or mistyped MeSH/technique lexicon entry is recognized as if it were a specific clinical biomarker or outcome.

Gene-panel / co-occurrence-list artifacts: entities that are merely co-listed in a panel, cluster, or abbreviations glossary (e.g. a network-clustering analysis, a proteomics panel, a front-matter glossary) are extracted as if a relation between them had been asserted.

Off-topic-disease leakage persists at meaningful volume: ARDS/critical-care, perimenopause, and neuroleptic-malignant-syndrome sentences all contributed spurious 'AD' triplets purely from lexicon term co-occurrence.

Directionality loss remains common even post-fix: several drugs shown to reduce/slow an outcome (galantamine and mortality, gantenerumab and disease progression) are stored identically to drugs that cause it.
note_on_variance: The two 30-item draws differ substantially in their own right (seed 42: 17%/20%/63%; seed 43: 27%/27%/47%), a reminder that a single n=30 sample is not a precise instrument for a graph of this size and heterogeneity; we report the pooled n=60 figure as our best single estimate but do not claim tight statistical confidence around it (paper Appendix H).
